Mobile app · Case study

Campus Lost & Found

Helping university students recover lost belongings.

OverviewResearchPersona & journeyDesignTesting

The problem

Students lose belongings on campus and spend hours searching. This project explored a mobile reporting and recovery experience for hostel students.

The approach

Survey research, personas, journey mapping, wireframes, interface design, and Maze prototype testing.

Project context

University mobile app concept · 2024
Case study by Prabhath Rathnayaka and Zulfa Zulfikar.

Understanding the problem

Survey feedback highlighted lengthy searches, mixed satisfaction with campus security, and interest in a dedicated app.

Persona & journey

The persona and wallet-recovery journey helped map students’ needs and pain points.

From ideas to interfaces

Exploration covered community alerts, detailed notifications, QR labels, and reporting stolen items. Flows and wireframes shaped the mobile experience.

Testing & refinement

Maze feedback led to easier contact between users, a combined Lost/Found feed, and clearer location entry. The work reinforced the value of testing and iterating with users.
